description: This file contains unit tests for the CommandSubscription class in the MQTT adapter module of the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies the behavior of subscription pattern parsing, tenant and device ID extraction, QoS handling, and security constraints within MQTT command subscriptions.

classes.name: CommandSubscriptionTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that validates the subscription pattern parsing, extraction, and validation logic of the CommandSubscription class for MQTT command topics.

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauth
methods.description: Tests creating a subscription from an unauthenticated topic string and verifies tenant, device ID, endpoint, and request part extraction.

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauthShort
methods.description: Tests subscription pattern with a short form topic string without authentication.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuth
methods.description: Validates subscription creation with an authenticated device and correct topic pattern.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithQoS
methods.description: Checks subscription creation with an authenticated device, including QoS level, and verifies correct property extraction.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithDifferentDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the device ID in the topic differs from the authenticated device, representing gateway subscription scenarios.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthShort
methods.description: Tests subscription pattern with minimal topic parts, ensuring successful parsing.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthDeviceDifferent
methods.description: Ensures that subscriptions with mismatched tenant and device IDs are rejected when authentication is involved.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithPattern
methods.description: Validates pattern matching and extraction with wildcards for tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithoutTenantDevice
methods.description: Tests handling of topics with missing tenant and device IDs (represented by empty segments).

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauthWithPattern
methods.description: Checks that unauthenticated subscriptions requiring specific patterns are rejected.

methods.name: testSubscriptionEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies rejected subscription patterns with invalid endpoint prefix.

methods.name: testSubscriptionReq
methods.description: Ensures subscription with invalid request part is rejected.

methods.name: testSubscriptionEnd
methods.description: Checks that incorrect ending parts in topics are rejected.

methods.name: testSubscriptionParts
methods.description: Verifies that topics with invalid number of parts are rejected.

methods.name: getCommandEndpoint
methods.description: Helper method to switch between legacy and current command endpoint for testing.

methods.name: useLegacyCommandEndpoint
methods.description: Override point for subclasses to decide whether to use legacy command endpoint; defaults to false.
